### Create pull request

I want to:

1. Ask me for target branch name.
2. Run git diff target..source to extract changes. the source branch is the current branch
3. Read .github/pull_request_template.md.
4. Fill placeholders in pull_request_template.md with the diff summary.
5. Show me PR title + body for review. The PR title should be the first commit message in source branch
6. Once I approve, call GitHub MCP create_pull_request with my input.
